label: write-combined pinned pipeline buffers for large inputs
hypothesis: Use write-combined CUDA host allocation for large pipeline gather destinations, preserving fresh CPU gather and H2D while reducing the combined transport cost.
expected_bottleneck: Frozen A0001 component diagnostic:16384/32768-token gather+H2D means3.869776/7.856003 ms torch pinned versus2.983973/5.945323 write-combined; native default allocation3.892142/7.923771 controls allocation API.2048 tokens slightly worse with WC, so exclude small inputs.
change: Pipeline inputs >=8192 tokens use cudaHostAllocWriteCombined destinations; keep ordinary CPU table, GPU buffers, capacities, gather/transfer/event order and precision. Bulk and smaller pipeline calls retain torch pinned allocation.
tradeoffs: CPU reads from WC memory may be slow; this path only writes gathered outputs and DMA reads them.
External allocation lifetime must outlive all tensor views and in-flight DMA. Synchronize device before cudaFreeHost, with allocation owner tied to buffer storage.
No extra table pinning or cross-call lookup cache; unchanged retained byte counts still require audited host/GPU capacities.
arithmetic_contract: Placement-only, zero absolute/relative tolerance against folded resident reference.
primary_target: b8 prefill; unchanged b1 and decode cannot nominate gain
draft_condition: Activated after A0016 accepted verdict; conditional merge preserves its small-prefill policy and all tests.
draft_validation: Syntax compile only. GPU tests pending A0016 verdict and parent reconciliation.
eligible_gain_note: Structured representation of the primary target already declared at registration; unchanged scope.
